summaryText: Gideon admitted he stabilized a fitting at the relief days before Ashcombe died.
Gideon initially claimed he hadn't worked at the relief at all — a lie, until the resin on the clasp proved otherwise.
Peeves recalls seeing Gideon near the old corridor shortly before Ashcombe's death — timing uncertain, a possible lead only.
Brief hesitation, physical tension, evasive wording — Benedict recognizes the phrase "Silent Lion" but won't confirm it outright. Significance unknown.
